main_text.p: Quae in hoc opere plenius traduntur & distinctius memorantur; Ubi major numerus Dissertationem, ex minoribus, prior Sectionem, posterior Paragraphum, designant.
Abbas ab Urbano VIII. creatur nondum gefices intrudit. V. 29. nitus infans, forte nunquam nasciturus, VIII. 2. 22.

Per Accessum Pontificem eligendi forma post Scrutinium insufficiens IV. 3. 63. quale semper fere est, 64. adhibetur; Est autem accedendi consuetudo ex Antiquitate Romana; Actus ejus diversi enumerantur, 65. Differentia inter antecedentia & actum primum accedentem numero qualis maneat, 78. Pontifices ... (continues) ... Concluditur tractatio de Scrutinio & Accessu. 74.
Adamus pretiosus Caroli Aud. Burg. Ducis jus eligendi Pontificem IV. 1. 12. tandem tiarae Pontificiae inscritur, VIII. I. 43.
Adelberti Tusciae Marchionis adultera Pontifices intrudit: V. 29. Adorationis vox quid Latinis significet VIII. 1. 9.
de Adoratione Pontificum; Vide Pontifices, per Adorationem Pontifices eligendi mos ... in Adorantibus numerandis fraus VI 4.17.
Adrianus I cum Synodo asserit Carolo M. ... IV. 1. 12.

Numbers in the entries are references to the Dissertations, Sections and Paragraphs as printed.

page.notes: The table, the column entries and the right-hand column are only partly legible in the scan; the figures and abbreviations are copied as best read, and several entries are shortened with "..." where the scan is unreadable. The "..." in running text stands for lines I could not read and should be checked against the original. Ornamental border between the table and the title is not text.
